## Overview

I applied tidyverse workflows to clean, reshape, summarize, and visualize datasets such as `airquality`, `relig_income`, `us_rent_income`, and `nycflights13`.

The project strengthened one of the foundations of practical analysis: data must be structured correctly before it can produce reliable charts, tables, or recommendations.

## Skills Demonstrated

- Converting between data frames and tibbles.
- Filtering, grouping, summarizing, and joining data.
- Pivoting between wide and long formats.
- Handling missing values.
- Building visualizations with `ggplot2`.

## Insight

This work showed me how tidy data principles make analysis easier to communicate, especially when transforming raw datasets into charts and tables that answer a specific business question.

## Professional Takeaway

The most transferable skill is the ability to inspect a dataset, identify whether it is wide or long, reshape it when needed, and then build a visual explanation from the cleaned structure.
